tables.name: profiles
tables.fields: user_id:uuid PK/FK auth.users.id; display_name:text; locale:text=es-MX; created_at:timestamptz; updated_at:timestamptz
tables.rules: Perfil personal del usuario, sin roles ni datos de negocio. Lectura/escritura propia. No replicar password ni tokens de Auth.

tables.name: organizations
tables.fields: name:text; slug:text; industry:text=general; timezone:text=America/Mexico_City; currency:char(3)=MXN; healthcare_enabled:boolean=false; clinical_ai_enabled:boolean=false; status:text=active; created_by_user_id:uuid FK auth.users.id
tables.rules: UNIQUE(slug). industry: general/dental/medical; healthcare_enabled implica dental o medical; clinical_ai_enabled implica healthcare_enabled. status: active/suspended/archived. El id de esta fila es el tenant; no lleva organization_id a si misma.

tables.name: organization_members
tables.fields: user_id:uuid FK auth.users.id; role:text=member; clinical_role:text?; clinical_scope:text=assigned; status:text=active; joined_at:timestamptz
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,user_id). role: owner/admin/member. clinical_role: doctor/dentist/clinical_assistant/reception o NULL. clinical_scope: assigned/organization. Cambios de rol/alcance solo por operacion autorizada; nunca UPDATE libre ni user_metadata. No eliminar al ultimo owner activo; suspender sin borrar autoria.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: business_profiles
tables.fields: city:text?; ideal_customer:text?; whatsapp_phone:text?; tone:text?; primary_goal:text?; onboarding_step:smallint=0; onboarding_completed_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id). onboarding_step entre 0 y 9. Nombre/industria se leen de organizations; servicios y precios se leen de services. No duplicarlos en arrays mutables.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: services
tables.fields: code:text; name:text; description:text?; price:numeric(14,2)=0; duration_minutes:integer?; active:boolean=true
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,code). price >= 0; duration_minutes > 0 si existe. Moneda heredada de organization. Un precio historico en un presupuesto no cambia al editar el catalogo.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: member_permissions
tables.fields: member_id:uuid; permission:text; granted_by_member_id:uuid?; grant_source:text; revoked_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: Una concesion activa por miembro/permission, mediante indice UNIQUE parcial WHERE revoked_at IS NULL. permission pertenece a catalogo cerrado: clinical.read/write/approve/files.read/files.write/ai.request/access.manage, quotes.read/write/discount, audit.read. grant_source: system/human; human exige granted_by. Cambios auditados y sujetos a autorizacion distinta de owner/admin comercial.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: patient_care_team
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; member_id:uuid; granted_by_member_id:uuid?; active:boolean=true
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,patient_id,member_id). Es alcance de pacientes, no permiso por si solo. Acceso requiere ademas membership activo y permiso clinico. Un usuario con clinical_scope=assigned necesita esta asignacion activa.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: contacts
tables.fields: display_name:text; email:text?; phone:text?; source:text?; customer_since:timestamptz?; archived_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: Nombre no vacio. email/phone no son UNIQUE globales ni por tenant: pueden compartirse. No almacenar diagnosticos ni notas clinicas. Cliente se identifica por customer_since; no se crea otra tabla clients para duplicar identidad.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: pipeline_stages
tables.fields: stage_key:text; name:text; position:integer; active:boolean=true
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,stage_key), UNIQUE(organization_id,position) DEFERRABLE. Ocho etapas iniciales: Nuevo, Contactado, Interesado, Cita propuesta, Cita agendada, Cliente, Seguimiento, Perdido. Reordenar dentro de una transaccion.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: leads
tables.fields: contact_id:uuid; stage_id:uuid; service_id:uuid?; assigned_member_id:uuid?; title:text; source:text?; estimated_value:numeric(14,2)=0; status:text=open; converted_at:timestamptz?; closed_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: status: open/won/lost. estimated_value >= 0. Una persona puede tener varias oportunidades. Cambio de etapa, conversion y registro en activities deben ser atomicos. Pasar a Seguimiento no debe deshacer customer_since; la conversion es un evento explicito.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: activities
tables.fields: contact_id:uuid; lead_id:uuid?; actor_member_id:uuid?; kind:text; body:text?; metadata:jsonb={}; occurred_at:timestamptz
tables.rules: kind: administrative_note/call/message/stage_change/conversion. Solo contexto administrativo; metadata con lista de campos permitidos. Timeline append-only; correcciones como evento nuevo. Lead opcional debe pertenecer al MISMO contacto.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: followups
tables.fields: contact_id:uuid; lead_id:uuid?; assigned_member_id:uuid?; due_at:timestamptz; status:text=pending; result:text?; completed_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: status: pending/completed/cancelled. completed exige completed_at y resultado. Vencidos/Hoy/Manana son filtros calculados con timezone del negocio, no estados adicionales.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: appointments
tables.fields: contact_id:uuid; lead_id:uuid?; assigned_member_id:uuid?; service_id:uuid?; starts_at:timestamptz; ends_at:timestamptz; status:text=scheduled; administrative_note:text?
tables.rules: ends_at > starts_at. status: scheduled/confirmed/completed/cancelled/no_show. Relacion con lead mantiene contacto. Solapamientos de recursos se resolveran en el modulo de citas; no se presume que todos los negocios tengan la misma politica.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: communication_preferences
tables.fields: contact_id:uuid; channel:text; preference:text=unknown; source:text; recorded_at:timestamptz
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,contact_id,channel). channel: email/whatsapp/sms/phone. preference: unknown/opted_in/opted_out. No asumir consentimiento por existir un contacto. Registrar evidencia de cambios; validacion juridica por canal pendiente, no se afirma cumplimiento legal.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: scripts
tables.fields: title:text; category:text; body:text; variables:jsonb=[]; active:boolean=true
tables.rules: variables es una lista validada de nombres, no SQL/codigo ejecutable. Contenido inicial se copia por tenant. No usar organization_id NULL para bibliotecas globales.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: script_favorites
tables.fields: member_id:uuid; script_id:uuid
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,member_id,script_id). Favorito individual; no columna is_favorite compartida por toda la organizacion.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: prompts
tables.fields: title:text; category:text; body:text; variables:jsonb=[]; version:integer=1; active:boolean=true
tables.rules: version > 0. Categorias del Master Prompt: Marketing, Sales, Content, WhatsApp, Research, Offers, Ads, Customer Service, Productivity. Nunca incrustar secretos en el texto.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: prompt_favorites
tables.fields: member_id:uuid; prompt_id:uuid
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,member_id,prompt_id). Propiedad de la preferencia individual.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: campaigns
tables.fields: name:text; objective:text; audience:text; offer:text; channel:text; initial_message:text?; cta:text?; followup_plan:jsonb=[]; kpi_definition:jsonb={}; status:text=draft; scheduled_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: status: draft/ready/active/completed/archived. Plan persistente no equivale a envio real. JSON con esquema y sin IDs de entidades que deban tener FK.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: content_items
tables.fields: campaign_id:uuid?; channel:text; content_type:text; body:text; status:text=idea; planned_at:timestamptz?; published_at:timestamptz?; external_url:text?
tables.rules: status: idea/pending/created/published. Publicado requiere confirmacion de publicacion y published_at; no marcar publicado al generar texto IA.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: reviews
tables.fields: contact_id:uuid; appointment_id:uuid?; status:text=pending; request_message:text?; requested_at:timestamptz?; received_at:timestamptz?; external_url:text?
tables.rules: status: pending/requested/received. Appointment debe corresponder al contacto. Registrar una solicitud no demuestra que se haya publicado una resena.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: reactivation_campaigns
tables.fields: name:text; inactivity_days:integer; channel:text; message_template:text; segment_snapshot_at:timestamptz?; status:text=draft
tables.rules: inactivity_days IN (30,60,90,180,365). status: draft/ready/active/completed/archived. Definir actividad comercial elegible sin consultar contenido clinico.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: reactivation_recipients
tables.fields: reactivation_campaign_id:uuid; contact_id:uuid; status:text=pending; last_activity_at:timestamptz?; message_snapshot:text?; contacted_at:timestamptz?; reactivated_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,reactivation_campaign_id,contact_id). status: pending/contacted/reactivated/excluded. Volver a comprobar preferencias antes de enviar. La captura de segmento evita que la lista cambie silenciosamente.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: sops
tables.fields: slug:text; title:text; objective:text; duration_minutes:integer?; steps:jsonb=[]; checklist:jsonb=[]; script_examples:jsonb=[]; kpi_definition:jsonb={}; version:integer=1
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,slug). JSON guarda contenido y ejemplos, no relaciones sin FK. Version positiva; conservar versiones publicadas cuando sean consumidas.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: courses
tables.fields: slug:text; title:text; description:text?; status:text=draft
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,slug). status: draft/published/archived. Distribucion inicial mediante copia tenant de plantillas, no datos privados globales.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: lessons
tables.fields: course_id:uuid; title:text; position:integer; content:jsonb={}; duration_minutes:integer?; active:boolean=true
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,course_id,position) DEFERRABLE. position >= 0; contenido validado y sanitizado en renderizado.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: lesson_progress
tables.fields: member_id:uuid; lesson_id:uuid; progress_percent:smallint=0; completed_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,member_id,lesson_id). Progreso entre 0 y 100; completed_at exige 100. Usuario actualiza solo su progreso autorizado.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: ai_generations
tables.fields: requested_by_member_id:uuid; operation:text; provider:text; model:text; prompt_version:text; status:text=pending; sanitized_input:jsonb={}; output:jsonb?; input_tokens:integer?; output_tokens:integer?; error_code:text?; finished_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: Solo IA comercial. status: pending/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled. No almacenar API keys ni contenido clinico. Tokens no negativos cuando se conozcan. Estado exitoso requiere resultado, no un mock silencioso.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: metrics_events
tables.fields: event_name:text; contact_id:uuid?; lead_id:uuid?; actor_member_id:uuid?; occurred_at:timestamptz; idempotency_key:text; properties:jsonb={}
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,idempotency_key). Append-only. Solo eventos administrativos validados; no clinicos. Si lead_id existe, contact_id debe existir y coincidir. Las metricas agregadas se calculan, no se inventan ni duplican como valores manuales.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: audit_events
tables.fields: actor_member_id:uuid?; actor_kind:text; action:text; entity_type:text; entity_id:uuid?; occurred_at:timestamptz; safe_metadata:jsonb={}
tables.rules: Append-only. actor_kind: member/system; miembro exige actor_member_id. entity_id es referencia historica intencional, no base de autorizacion ni FK polimorfica. Sin textos clinicos, passwords o tokens. Sin UPDATE/DELETE desde cliente.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: patients
tables.fields: contact_id:uuid; record_number:text; birth_date:date?; demographic_data:jsonb={}; archived_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,contact_id), UNIQUE(organization_id,record_number). Contacto 0..1 paciente por organizacion. No duplicar telefono/email/nombre. Demografia adicional permanece protegida en el contexto clinico.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: clinical_templates
tables.fields: template_key:text; kind:text; specialty:text; version:integer; definition:jsonb; active:boolean=true
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,template_key,version). kind: history/progress_note/consent. Version > 0. La version publicada/usada no se sobrescribe; una modificacion crea nueva version.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: clinical_histories
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; template_id:uuid; version:integer; status:text=draft; supersedes_history_id:uuid?; authored_by_member_id:uuid; finalized_by_member_id:uuid?; finalized_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,patient_id,version). status: draft/final. Final exige aprobador y fecha. La historia y secciones finales se vuelven inmutables; una correccion crea version nueva del mismo paciente. Prevencion de ciclos en supersedes mediante transaccion/trigger.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: clinical_history_sections
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; history_id:uuid; section_key:text; position:integer; payload:jsonb
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,history_id,section_key). Una seccion pertenece a historia y paciente coincidentes. payload validado contra la version de plantilla. Bloquear cambios de secciones cuando la historia esta finalizada.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: clinical_encounters
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; contact_id:uuid; appointment_id:uuid?; practitioner_member_id:uuid; started_at:timestamptz; ended_at:timestamptz?; status:text=in_progress; reason:text?
tables.rules: status: in_progress/completed/cancelled. ended_at >= started_at. FK paciente+contacto y cita+contacto garantizan que la cita corresponde al paciente, no solo al tenant. Maximo un encuentro por cita no nula, UNIQUE parcial. Completar cita no firma notas.
tables.query_indexes: (organization_id,patient_id,started_at DESC,id); UNIQUE(organization_id,appointment_id) WHERE appointment_id IS NOT NULL
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: progress_notes
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; encounter_id:uuid; authored_by_member_id:uuid; template_id:uuid?; version:integer; source:text=manual; ai_generation_id:uuid?; content:jsonb; status:text=draft; supersedes_note_id:uuid?; approved_by_member_id:uuid?; approved_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,encounter_id,version). status: draft/final; source: manual/ai. source=ai exige ai_generation_id. Final exige aprobacion explicita con permiso clinical.approve. Contenido final inmutable; correcciones por version/adenda. Comprobar que AI y nota corresponden tambien al mismo encuentro cuando AI lo tenga. supersedes dentro del mismo encuentro.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: patient_documents
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; encounter_id:uuid?; uploaded_by_member_id:uuid; bucket_id:text; object_path:text; original_filename:text; mime_type:text; size_bytes:bigint; sha256:text?; category:text; status:text=pending
tables.rules: UNIQUE(bucket_id,object_path). size_bytes >= 0 con limite configurable. status: pending/available/quarantined/deleted. Ubicacion privada sin URL firmada persistida. Operaciones Storage via API, no DML directo a storage.objects. No asumir atomicidad entre archivo y metadata.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: clinical_images
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; encounter_id:uuid?; uploaded_by_member_id:uuid; bucket_id:text; object_path:text; original_filename:text; mime_type:text; size_bytes:bigint; image_type:text; acquired_at:timestamptz?; deidentification_reviewed:boolean=false; status:text=pending
tables.rules: UNIQUE(bucket_id,object_path). Archivo privado; image_type usa catalogo validado. Revision de anonimato no se infiere de la extension. status: pending/available/quarantined/deleted. Analisis IA solo a peticion, no al subir.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: consents
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; encounter_id:uuid?; template_id:uuid; document_id:uuid?; status:text=draft; granted_at:timestamptz?; revoked_at:timestamptz?; recorded_by_member_id:uuid; evidence_metadata:jsonb={}
tables.rules: status: draft/granted/revoked. granted exige evidencia y fecha; revoked exige fecha. Documento/encuentro del mismo paciente. Registro de evidencia no equivale por si mismo a firma electronica legalmente valida.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: treatment_plans
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; encounter_id:uuid?; authored_by_member_id:uuid; title:text; clinical_notes:text?; currency:char(3); status:text=draft
tables.rules: status: draft/presented/accepted/partially_accepted/rejected/completed. Datos clinicos; recepcion no recibe automaticamente detalles. Estado debe concordar con items en operacion transaccional.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: treatment_plan_items
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; plan_id:uuid; service_id:uuid?; procedure_label:text; tooth_or_region:text?; position:integer; quantity:numeric(10,2); unit_price:numeric(14,2); discount_amount:numeric(14,2)=0; status:text=proposed
tables.rules: quantity > 0, unit_price >= 0, 0 <= discount_amount <= round(quantity*unit_price,2). status: proposed/accepted/rejected/completed. Snapshot de precio/texto. tooth_or_region no implica odontograma implementado. Total de linea calculado; moneda del plan.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: quotes
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; plan_id:uuid?; quote_number:text; revision:integer=1; supersedes_quote_id:uuid?; currency:char(3); status:text=draft; valid_until:date?; presented_at:timestamptz?; authored_by_member_id:uuid
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,quote_number,revision). Estados segun Master Prompt: draft/presented/accepted/partially_accepted/rejected/completed. Presupuesto clinico protegido incluso si aparece en ficha CRM. Al presentar, congelar cantidades/precios; cambios como revision. Total calculado desde items, no numero arbitrario del cliente.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: quote_items
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; quote_id:uuid; plan_id:uuid?; plan_item_id:uuid?; service_id:uuid?; description:text; position:integer; quantity:numeric(10,2); unit_price:numeric(14,2); discount_amount:numeric(14,2)=0; decision:text=pending
tables.rules: quantity > 0; precios/descuentos como plan_items. decision: pending/accepted/rejected. Si plan_item_id existe, plan_id obligatorio y debe coincidir con el plan del presupuesto; trigger/operacion transaccional valida esta regla entre filas. FK item+plan y paciente+quote. No copiar diagnosticos al resumen administrativo.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: clinical_ai_generations
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; encounter_id:uuid?; requested_by_member_id:uuid; operation:text; provider:text; model:text; prompt_version:text; status:text=pending; input_manifest:jsonb={}; original_output:jsonb?; error_code:text?; finished_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: operation: image_analysis/note_draft/transcription. status: pending/running/succeeded/failed/cancelled. Original exitoso inmutable; salida NO es diagnostico ni nota aprobada. Manifest minimizado; no guardar audio/texto completo sin necesidad. El analisis clinico no aparece en ai_generations comercial.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: radiograph_ai_analyses
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid; clinical_image_id:uuid; generation_id:uuid; review_status:text=pending; reviewed_result:jsonb?; reviewed_by_member_id:uuid?; reviewed_at:timestamptz?
tables.rules: UNIQUE(organization_id,generation_id). Ambos recursos del mismo paciente. review_status: pending/accepted/edited/discarded. Revision distinta de pending exige revisor/fecha. Resultado original permanece en clinical_ai_generations; guardar version revisada separada. Nuevas revisiones conservan trazabilidad, no reescriben original.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT

tables.name: clinical_audit_events
tables.fields: patient_id:uuid?; actor_member_id:uuid?; actor_kind:text; action:text; entity_type:text; entity_id:uuid?; occurred_at:timestamptz; safe_metadata:jsonb={}
tables.rules: Append-only y sin borrado en cascada. Registrar accesos/cambios/firma/archivos/IA mediante rutas o funciones controladas. Un trigger de escritura NO registra SELECT; lectura auditada necesita mecanismo especifico. Sin copiar expedientes completos, tokens ni claves al log.
common_columns: organization_id:uuid NOT NULL FK organizations.id ON DELETE RESTRICT
